messages:
Alex: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem (eviction spike). TL;DR: we need owners + firm timelines for 4 items. I'll propose a RACI and suggested ETAs below — please ack and update the tickets by EOD tomorrow.

Anya: Got it. Can we split infra vs app tasks? Also flagging this is a recurring pattern roughly every ~3 weeks; should be noted in the playbook.

Ben: Agree. I can take the automatic eviction threshold tuning item unless someone else prefers.

Chandra: I will own runbook updates + alert thresholds. RACI draft: R=Chandra, A=Alex, C=Priya (QA), I=Ben.

Priya (QA): I'll own the regression test set and acceptance criteria. ETA: ready for review by Fri 03/15.

Alex: Thanks — created tickets and linked to PM-2410: INF-3872 (threshold tuning), INF-3873 (runbook + alerts), INF-3874 (regression suite + CI gating), INF-3875 (postmortem dashboard/metrics).

Incident Bot: Created Jira issues INF-3872, INF-3873, INF-3874, INF-3875 and linked them to PM-2410.

Ben: INF-3872 assigned to Ben. ETA 2 weeks. I'll add a minimal repro and current perf numbers to the ticket.

Chandra: INF-3873 assigned to Chandra. I propose 1 week for runbook edits, alert threshold tuning, and oncall swimlane updates.

Priya (QA): INF-3874 assigned to Priya. I'll add synthetic tests that replicate prefix/KV cache thrash and gate merges in CI.

Alex: Regarding handoffs: for the initial remediation window we'll rotate primary oncall ownership weekdays 9–5: Ben (week 1) -> Chandra (week 2) -> Alex (week 3) to avoid owner drift. Also adding acceptance checklist to INF-3874.

Anya: Can we add a "ticket aging" clause to the closure playbook so action items get a forced review at 5 days? Too many items sit idle.

Alex: Good call. Proposed Jira automation snippet to add to playbook and attach to the PM template:

```
Jira Automation:
when: issue created or updated
if: status != Done and days since created >= 5
then: add comment "Owner review required: please update ETA or assign escalation"; transition to "Needs Review"; ping #postmortems
```

Ben: Ack. I'll update INF-3872 with perf numbers and a set of config values to try.

Chandra: Ping me if you need access to alerting dashboards or the escalation runbook; I'll share links in INF-3873.

Priya (QA): Once I have the regression PR I'll schedule a 15m sync to walk through acceptance gates. :calendar:

Alex: Closing the loop — please update your assigned tickets (owner field + ETA + short acceptance criteria) by EOD tomorrow. If anyone expects delays, flag in the ticket and notify PM ops so we can reassign. :thumbsup:
